The calendar is set up on the "Agenda-manifestations" dataset, with the event name as the label and crowd sourcing turned on. The form is valid.

- **Jeu de données:** Agenda-manifestations.
- **Champ de libellé:** "Nom de l'évenement" (`nomevenement`). This is the only event-name column; there is also a separate "Nom" column, which I did not use.
- **Activer le crowd sourcing:** on.

Crowd sourcing also shows a field I left empty: **Jeu de données des contributions externes**. This is where visitors' proposed events would be stored. It is not marked required, so the form validates without it. The suggestions include "Agenda-manifestations" itself (the same dataset, which would mix proposals with published events), and several other calendar datasets. Tell me which one to use, or whether to leave it empty.

The other crowd-sourcing options are at their defaults: "Supprimer les contributions après validation" is off and the contribution colour is `#7AA95C`.
